Bio-degradable real wood material, Free of BPA / PVC / lead / phthalates / latex & Toxic substances

faq.question: What are Coconut Shell RFID Wristbands commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for eco-forward resorts, festivals, and membership programs that want a natural-material wristband without losing RFID credential functionality.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Coconut Shell RFID Wristbands?
faq.answer: Chip: Mifare 1k, f08, Ntag 213, Icode 2,Ultralight or customized chip. Read Range: 2-5cm depend on rfid reader

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for Coconut Shell RFID Wristbands?
faq.answer: Material: Coconut Shell, Fabric Form Factor: Wearable wristband form factor for access control or event use. Size: 31x26mm or customized.

faq.question: How can Coconut Shell RFID Wristbands be customized?
faq.answer: Encoding: the content provided by client. Finishing Options: Laser engrave logo, Serial numbers.
